items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Who, Diz? I don't know what Diz did. ... Charlie Shavers and Dizzy Gillespie both went to this school. Dizzy was a bad boy; Dizzy got kicked out of school.

ctx.x: What did Dizzy get kicked out for?

Who, Diz? I don't know what Diz did. But at that time you could get kicked out of school for smoking. And I got caught smoking once, and I got one demerit, and it just took three demerits to get kicked out. It was a real ROTC.

Years later...I guess it's all right to tell it now... But when the War started, I never did tell them I went to ROTC school. See, I was officer material, but I never put that down. For whatever reason, I was in 1A the whole duration of the War and never got called. I was on a 21-day furlough and they never called me.
